body: Orchestrate everything, everywhere. The open-source control plane for workflows across data, infrastructure, business processes and AI agents. Declarative YAML, event-driven, any language, Git-versioned, scalable to millions of executions.
plain_description: **Automate data, AI, and infrastructure workflows from one place.** Build scheduled or event-driven processes in the UI or with YAML. Connect tools and services through Kestra’s plugin ecosystem.
technical_description: Kestra is an open-source, event-driven orchestration platform for data, AI, and infrastructure workflows. It supports declarative YAML, a no-code editor, an AI Copilot, scheduled and event triggers, and plugins for scripts, databases, cloud services, and APIs. Workflows can be version controlled and run locally, remotely, in Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud environments. It includes AI agent and RAG workflow capabilities and a built-in MCP server.
title: Kestra
